Протокол верхнего уровня. CANopen — ID к: Higher-layer protocol. CANopen: the frame ID is computed from the frame type and node_id; SAE J1939: from PGN, priority and the device address; CAN: each frame has an explicit ID.
Скорость шины в бит/с, напр. 250000 или: Bus bitrate in bit/s, e.g. 250000 or 500000. Shown in documents and DBC.
Физический интерфейс или разъём, напр. «: Physical interface or connector, e.g. “CAN1, X3”. Used in documents only.
Шина CAN FD: кадры до 64 байт (DLC 0..8,: CAN FD bus: frames up to 64 bytes (DLC 0..8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, 64).
CANopen node address 1..127 (0x01..0x7F). Added to the base ID of PDO, SDO, EMCY and Heartbeat frames.
Адрес источника J1939 (Source Address) 0: J1939 source address 0..253 (0x00..0xFD). Forms the low byte of every frame ID the device sends; 254 and 255 are reserved.
Тип кадра CANopen. Задаёт базовый ID (на: CANopen frame type. Sets the base ID (e.g. PDO TX 1 = 0x180 + node_id) and the default direction. raw means the ID is set explicitly.
CAN ID кадра: 11 бит (0x000..0x7FF) или: Frame CAN ID: 11-bit (0x000..0x7FF) or 29-bit (up to 0x1FFFFFFF). Leave empty to compute it: for CANopen from the type and node_id, for J1939 from the PGN, priority and address.
Номер группы параметров J1939, 0..0x3FFF: J1939 parameter group number, 0..0x3FFFF. PF < 240 (0xF0) means PDU1, a destination-specific frame: the low byte of the PGN must be 0 and the destination is set separately. PF ≥ 240 means PDU2, broadcast.
J1939 priority 0..7: the top 3 bits of the ID. Lower values mean higher priority. Default 6.
Адрес получателя для PDU1-кадра J1939, 0: Destination address for a J1939 PDU1 frame, 0..255. 0xFF means all nodes.
Длина данных кадра в байтах: 0..8, для C: Frame data length in bytes: 0..8, up to 64 for CAN FD. Default 8.
29-битный (расширенный) идентификатор вм: Use a 29-bit (extended) identifier instead of an 11-bit one.
Как трактовать значение. enum — таблица: How the value is interpreted. enum — a value table; flag — a single yes/no bit; bitfield — a set of flags; scaled — a scaled value: raw × factor + offset; raw — an integer as is; float — IEEE 754; bytes — a byte array. The form shows only the fields the chosen type needs.
Порядок байт многобайтового сигнала. lit: Byte order of a multi-byte signal. little-endian (Intel): least significant byte first, typical for CANopen and J1939. big-endian (Motorola): most significant byte first.
Значение может быть отрицательным. Спосо: The value can be negative. Choose how the sign is encoded in “Sign encoding”.
Как записано отрицательное число. Дополн: How negative numbers are encoded. Two's complement is the standard (−1 = all ones). Ones' complement inverts all bits (−1 = 1…10). Sign-magnitude uses the top bit for the sign and the rest for the magnitude (−1 = 10…01). This only affects documents: generated code and DBC use two's complement.
Множитель: физическое значение = raw × м: Multiplier: physical value = raw × factor + offset. E.g. 0.1 for voltage in 0.1 V steps.
Смещение: физическое значение = raw × ма: Offset: physical value = raw × factor + offset. E.g. −40 for temperature.
Допустимый минимум в физических единицах: Allowed minimum in physical units. Leave empty to use the limit of the signal width.
Допустимый максимум в физических единица: Allowed maximum in physical units. Leave empty to use the limit of the signal width.
Сигнал-селектор мультиплексора. Мультипл: Multiplexer selector signal. Multiplexing lets one frame carry different sets of signals: the selector value tells which signals the frame currently contains. A frame can have only one selector.
Значения селектора, при которых этот сиг: Selector values for which this signal is in the frame, e.g. 0 or 1, 2. Leave empty if the signal is always present. Requires a selector signal in the frame.
Значение после включения или до первого: Value after power-up or before the first message is received, in physical units. In C: …_INITIAL_RAW; in DBC: GenSigStartValue.
Сырые значения, означающие «нет данных /: Raw values that mean “no data / not valid”, e.g. 0xFF or 0xFE, 0xFF.
Как показывать значения таблицы enum в д: How enum table values are shown in documents: decimal or hex.
Смещение флага от младшего бита битового: Flag offset from the least significant bit of the bit field: 0 is the field's LSB.
Ширина флага в битах, по умолчанию 1. Бо: Flag width in bits, 1 by default. A width above 1 makes a multi-bit value inside the field.
Байт команды SDO (CCS/SCS), напр. 0x2B —: SDO command byte (CCS/SCS), e.g. 0x2B — write 2 bytes, 0x23 — write 4 bytes, 0x40 — read.
Номер младшего бита (LSB) сигнала в кадр: Position of the signal's least significant bit (LSB) in the frame, counting from 0. Bit N is in byte N div 8 at position N mod 8.
Когда кадр отправляется: циклически с за: When the frame is sent: cyclically at a set period, on event (when data changes) or on request.

Идентификатор шины: латинские буквы, циф: Bus identifier: Latin letters, digits and _, no spaces. Used in DBC and C file names and as an anchor in documents. Required.
Идентификатор устройства: латинские букв: Device identifier: Latin letters, digits and _. Used in generated code, DBC, and frame senders and receivers. Required.
Идентификатор кадра: латинские буквы, ци: Frame identifier: Latin letters, digits and _. Used in generated code and DBC. Required, unique on the bus.
Идентификатор сигнала: латинские буквы,: Signal identifier: Latin letters, digits and _. Used in generated code and DBC. Required, unique within the frame.
TX — кадр передаёт это устройство, RX —: TX — this device sends the frame, RX — it receives it. "By type" — from the CANopen frame type (PDO TX is sent, etc.); a frame without a type whose sender is another device is RX.
На шине нет других устройств: There are no other devices on the bus
Устройства этой шины, которые принимают: Devices on this bus that receive the frame. The owner of an RX frame is a receiver even without this list. Used in documents, DBC and each device's "Receives" summary.
Устройство не описано на шине: Device is not defined on the bus
Устройство не указано получателем ни одн: The device is not a receiver of any frame.
Устройство этой шины, которое передаёт к: Device on this bus that sends the frame when it is not the frame's owner: an RX frame (e.g. a node's RPDO sent by the master) or a bus frame (NMT, SYNC). Empty — the sender is not in the map. A frame sent by one of your devices is best described at the sender, with the receiving devices listed in "Receivers".
устройства шины, которые принимают кадр: bus devices that receive the frame
